## Percentile value for both Male and Female participants
```{r}
# Read the CSV file
df <- read.csv("hyrox_results_updated_V4.csv")

# Filter for participants who completed the race and have valid total_time
df_completed <- df %>%
  filter(tolower(completed) == "yes",
         !is.na(total_time),
         total_time > 0,
         tolower(gender) %in% c("male", "female"))

# Define percentile steps
percentile_levels <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)

# Function to calculate percentiles for a gender
get_percentile_table <- function(data, gender_label) {
  data_gender <- data %>%
    filter(tolower(gender) == tolower(gender_label))

  percentile_values <- quantile(data_gender$total_time, probs = percentile_levels)

  data.frame(
    Gender = gender_label,
    Percentile = percentile_levels * 100,
    Total_Time_Seconds = as.numeric(percentile_values),
    Total_Time_Minutes = round(as.numeric(percentile_values) / 60, 2)
  )
}

# Calculate percentile tables for men and women
percentiles_women <- get_percentile_table(df_completed, "female")
percentiles_men   <- get_percentile_table(df_completed, "male")

# Combine into one table
percentile_table <- bind_rows(percentiles_women, percentiles_men)

# View the result
print(percentile_table)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

key_percentiles <- c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)

# Function to get max histogram count
get_max_count <- function(data, binwidth = 200) {
  h <- hist(data$total_time,
            breaks = seq(min(data$total_time), max(data$total_time) + binwidth, binwidth),
            plot = FALSE)
  max(h$counts)
}

# Compute max counts per gender
max_counts <- df_completed %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(max_y = get_max_count(cur_data()), .groups = "drop")

# Prepare percentile lines
percentile_lines <- bind_rows(
  percentiles_men %>%
    filter(Percentile %in% (key_percentiles * 100)) %>%
    mutate(gender = "male"),
  percentiles_women %>%
    filter(Percentile %in% (key_percentiles * 100)) %>%
    mutate(gender = "female")
) %>%
  rename(xintercept = Total_Time_Seconds) %>%
  left_join(max_counts, by = "gender") %>%
  mutate(
    # Male labels slightly lower, female labels slightly down (but not too close to x-axis)
    y_pos = ifelse(gender == "male", max_y + 20, 25),
    vjust_value = ifelse(gender == "male", -0.3, 1.8)
  )

# Final Plot
ggplot(df_completed, aes(x = total_time, fill = gender)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 200, position = "identity", alpha = 0.3, color = "black") +

  geom_vline(
    data = percentile_lines,
    aes(xintercept = xintercept, color = gender),
    linetype = "dashed",
    size = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = percentile_lines,
    aes(x = xintercept, y = y_pos, label = paste0(Percentile, "th"), color = gender, vjust = vjust_value),
    angle = 0,
    size = 2.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Race Time Distribution with 25th, 50th, and 75th Percentile Lines",
    x = "Total Race Time (seconds)",
    y = "Number of Athletes",
    fill = "Gender",
    color = "Gender"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

```
